# Weekly Store Dashboard Overview

A simple dashboard should focus on **sales growth, marketing efficiency, and product quality signals** from the four weekly data points. The best design is a compact executive view with 3 charts and one weekly action note.

# Recommended Charts and What They Show

## 1) Revenue and Orders Trend
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/graph-up.svg

- **Chart type:** Dual-axis line chart or grouped bar chart
- **What it shows:** Whether order volume and revenue are rising together week by week
- **Why it matters:** Confirms if growth is coming from more orders, higher average order value, or both
- **Best dashboard insight:** Revenue and orders both peak on **2026-03-23**, showing the strongest week overall

## 2) Ad Spend vs Revenue Efficiency
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/currency-dollar.svg

- **Chart type:** Combo chart with bars for AdSpend and a line for Revenue
- **What it shows:** How much marketing spend is being used to generate sales
- **Why it matters:** Helps judge whether higher spend is producing proportionally higher revenue
- **Best dashboard insight:** Ad spend increased across the month, but revenue improved faster, especially in the final week

## 3) Returns Rate by Week
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/arrow-counterclockwise.svg

- **Chart type:** Column chart or line chart using Returns ÷ Orders
- **What it shows:** Product or fulfillment quality issues over time
- **Why it matters:** Rising returns can reduce profit even when sales look healthy
- **Best dashboard insight:** Return counts stayed relatively low, but the return rate is highest on **2026-03-23** because orders were strongest that week

# Weekly Business Insights

| Week | Orders | Revenue | AdSpend | Returns | Return Rate |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2026-03-02 | 120 | 4800 | 900 | 6 | 5.0% |
| 2026-03-09 | 135 | 5250 | 950 | 8 | 5.9% |
| 2026-03-16 | 128 | 5100 | 880 | 7 | 5.5% |
| 2026-03-23 | 150 | 6100 | 1020 | 9 | 6.0% |

- **Best overall week:** 2026-03-23 led in both orders and revenue.
- **Marketing efficiency improved:** Revenue grew faster than ad spend over the month.
- **Returns need monitoring:** Returns stayed modest, but the return rate drifted upward slightly.
- **Most useful KPI for the dashboard:** Revenue per ad dollar, alongside return rate, will quickly show whether growth is healthy.

# Next Week Marketing Review Action

- **Action:** Review the 2026-03-23 campaign mix and identify which channel or offer drove the revenue lift, then reallocate a small portion of budget toward the best-performing source while watching return rate closely.

# Sources

- CSV provided in the prompt
- Metric formulas used:
  - Return rate = Returns ÷ Orders
  - Revenue efficiency = Revenue ÷ AdSpend
